verdict.rationale: Basecamp is a SaaS project-management platform, so webhook event subscriptions are a fair question. The evidence pack documents a REST API, OpenAPI spec, OAuth, conditional GET (304 polling) and MCP support, but never mentions registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Calendar subscription and ETag polling are adjacent features and do not count as webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
